assessment.nobel_worthiness: Exact nonequilibrium fluctuation and work relations reveal remarkably general statistical laws, making irreversibility quantitatively analyzable at small scales.
assessment.attribution: Evans represents early fluctuation relations, Jarzynski the work equality, Crooks the forward/reverse work relation.
assessment.maturity: The mathematical results have precise assumptions and a mature numerical and experimental testing history.
uncertainties: Seifert is also credited. A citation centered on trajectory thermodynamics could require a different trio; the packet lacks a complete chronology and experimental-condition record.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Conformal symmetry turned broad classes of two-dimensional critical fluctuations into exactly analyzable systems, a foundational explanation of universality.
assessment.attribution: The supplied trio represents the shared conformal-field-theory breakthrough and complementary theoretical foundations.
assessment.maturity: The mathematical structure and its critical-model predictions are mature and extensively tested.
uncertainties: The packet does not delimit the joint foundational result from later integrability and other individual contributions; not every critical system falls within the same assumptions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A simple dynamical self-consistency principle made strongly correlated electrons tractable and connected many-body models to material observations.
assessment.attribution: Georges and Kotliar represent dynamical construction; Vollhardt the infinite-dimensional basis.
assessment.maturity: The framework is mature, with extensive numerical and experimental comparisons.
uncertainties: The full collaborator history is absent, and exact limiting theory must be distinguished from approximate material predictions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Defect-mediated melting and the hexatic phase explain how two-dimensional order disappears through universal topological mechanisms.
assessment.attribution: The three credited theorists represent the dislocation/disclination description and two-stage melting theory.
assessment.maturity: The theory has substantial numerical and experimental support in suitable systems.
uncertainties: The packet does not identify where continuous melting applies versus first-order alternatives or define the distinction from earlier recognized topological-transition work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and topological quantum phases identify a general mechanism linking global state structure to observable interference and transport.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov represents the electromagnetic phase effect, Berry general adiabatic geometric phases. These are distinct but related discoveries.
assessment.maturity: Both effects have mature theoretical and extensive experimental foundations.
uncertainties: The compound nomination needs a careful citation and potentially separate recognition; the packet does not resolve the complete original credit history.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Band topology gives an intelligible, robust organizing principle for electronic matter and observable boundary conduction.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele represent classification and prediction; Molenkamp quantum-spin-Hall realization.
assessment.maturity: The basic time-reversal-invariant phase is established and has durable theoretical and experimental reach.
uncertainties: Hasan is also credited. Including three-dimensional surface-state establishment could change attribution; detailed priority evidence is absent.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscapes and minimal frustration explain biological folding using statistical mechanisms familiar from disordered systems, with important interdisciplinary reach.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Bryngelson represent foundational landscape/minimal-frustration work; Onuchic development into quantitative folding theory.
assessment.maturity: The framework has sustained theoretical, simulation and experimental use.
uncertainties: The packet does not identify one sharp discovery or decisive quantitative tests against alternatives; landscape ideas do not universally determine individual protein kinetics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum error correction identifies how fragile information can be protected without reading out its value, a foundational principle linking computation and collective quantum structure.
assessment.attribution: Shor and Steane represent correcting quantum codes, Kitaev topological protection and fault-tolerant structures.
assessment.maturity: The theoretical principle is mature; experimental realization has progressed while large-scale fault tolerance remains developing.
uncertainties: The packet provides no contribution chronology or precise experimental evidence. Code invention, threshold results and topological architectures are distinct credit questions.
